'''Shaak Ridge''' was a row of hills in the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="GB" /> located south of the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], and north of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]], [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] attempted to place the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] atop the ridge, where he hoped to gain the high ground over the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Unfortunately, the Federation reached the ridge before the Gungans, and Ceel was forced to order an early halt in the valley. The battle started soon after the Gungans saw the Trade Federation vehicles emerge atop the Shaak Ridge.<ref name="GB" />
